text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to a lunch buffet
for a meal—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My, Trainer—what a coincidence, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We just got here too♪
Would you like to eat with us?
Right, Bouquet-chan?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes, as long as you're fine with it, Trainer-san—
choice_data_list: Well then, mind if I join you?
Well then, maybe I'll join you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... Well then, shall we be on our way—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —I have returned.
choice_data_list: Huh, you plated that really nicely!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
There was a great selection of salad, so I put together something nice and colorful.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: There were also cheese and nuts, so... I brought them along. I think the nutritional balance should be fine, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Bouquet-chan, your plate is
super cute! It looks like a flower field♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to making pretty things,
no one holds a candle to Bouquet-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No way... Curren-chan's plate is also...
—Ah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...
It looks like plating from a restaurant—no, maybe even better...
choice_data_list: Well now, this is quite extravagant...
Well now, this is quite extravagant...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Across several plates, Curren Chan beautifully arranged
a variety of dishes, ranging from meats and seafood
to salads and desserts.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
How's this?☆
I arranged the dish to look like a treasure chest!♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's truly—wonderful. So colorful and rich...
with such a wide variety of cuisines.
Above all—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at it... makes my heart leap.
Wondering what it tastes like,
what I should eat first...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
At a buffet—there is such
a complex harmony to be found, isn't there?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll—try one more time.
I will face the buffet and seek better harmony—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll build around the braised pork...
Ah, I took too much...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea roast beef could be arranged
like a flower like this...
In that case, I'll arrange these pickles like a flowerbed to go with it—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A fruit tart—such beautiful colors...
I'm sure if I arranged macarons next to it, it would look even more... gorgeous—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um—if you stare at me so intently...
it's... embarrassing...
choice_data_list: No, it's completely in harmony! Just—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Are you all right, Bouquet-chan?
Do you think you can eat all of this?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I got so... carried away serving it.
But it's okay. I'll take responsibility and—
choice_data_list: If there's too much, why don't the three of us share it?
If there's too much, why don't the three of us share it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I got so... carried away serving it.
But it's okay. I'll take responsibility and—
choice_data_list: If there's too much, why don't the three of us share it?
If there's too much, why don't the three of us share it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Huh, but are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse♪ Wanna share with Curren's too?
Trying a bit of everything is the best part of a buffet☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of them shared the food
and fully savored the buffet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Truth is, while I was
picking out the food, I got—
really hungry.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: And so—time to eat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Savoring every bit of happiness, Curren Bouquetd'or managed to polish off the entire meal splendidly.
